chunks: 4913 - And it is narrated from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"The mother of Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd said to Sulaymān عليه السلام: O my son, beware of excessive sleep at night, for excessive sleep at night leaves a man poor on the Day of Judgment."

key_terms.أُمُّ: mother; the speaker offering sincere moral counsel
key_terms.بِاللَّيْلِ: at night; the time especially associated with wakefulness for devotion
key_terms.فَقِيرًا: poor; deprived and lacking on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.كَثْرَةَ النَّوْمِ: excessive sleep; sleeping beyond what is beneficial or balanced
key_terms.يَا بُنَيَّ: O my son; an affectionate form of parental address
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Judgment; the final day of reckoning and recompense

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about excessive sleep at night and its effect in the Hereafter?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a moral exhortation through the words of the mother of Sulayman عليه السلام, warning against excessive sleep at night. It links spiritual negligence in this world with poverty on the Day of Judgment, emphasizing vigilance, discipline, and concern for the Hereafter.
